# Known OpenAPI drift — routes that are intentionally, permanently NOT part of
# the OpenAPI API surface: the scanner cannot resolve a runtime-computed
# METHOD/path, or the route serves something other than an API operation (a
# documentation UI, a non-API discovery document). This file is a permanent
# exclusion list, not a backlog: an entry here asserts "this route is not
# OpenAPI," never that its OpenAPI fragment simply does not exist in the
# codebase (#5762 -- POST /api/v0/code/visualize sat here under that second,
# false claim from #3781 until it got a real openapi_paths_code_graph.go
# entry). Because of that history, scripts/verify-openapi.sh enforces rules
# on this file: no comment line may contain one of a fixed set of deferral
# markers (a closed, conventional token set) or one of a fixed, best-effort
# list of prose deferral phrases -- neither list is exhaustive of every way a
# deferral could be phrased in English, only of the shapes already seen (see
# the script for the exact word lists -- inlining them here would make this
# explanation trip its own check), and every route entry must be preceded by
# its own non-empty, substantive comment justifying it; a justification
# cannot be shared across a group of routes.
#
# Format: METHOD /path (one per line, comments start with #)
#
# Documentation UIs — these serve HTML documentation, not an API surface.
GET /api/v0/docs
# Documentation UIs — these serve HTML documentation, not an API surface.
GET /api/v0/redoc
# RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (#5163, F-2). Served on the MCP
# origin's unauthenticated well-known surface, not the /api/v0 API — it is a
# discovery document (authorization_servers, resource) consumed by OAuth
# clients, not an API operation, so it is intentionally excluded from the
# OpenAPI paths.
GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
# RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (#5163, F-2), templated form.
# Same discovery-document rationale as the entry above.
GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/{rest...}
